name: @aiti-ai/pi-secret-vault
description: Encrypted secret vault for pi: store credentials once (/vault add, masked input), let the model query aliases (vault_list / vault_get → opaque rsec_ tokens) and pass those tokens into any tool argument, where the runtime substitutes the real value. AI is read-only; values never enter the chat, the session file, or the wire payload. Superset of @aiti-ai/pi-secret-mask (same engine; same-session coexistence resolves to the vault).
